model.legendFormat: failed refill tries in the hour before

annotations.summary: Backlog refills failed {{ printf "%.0f" $values.FailedTries.Value }} times in the last hour (it alerts at 3).
annotations.description: What it means: refills keep failing, whether one refill's three tries (ten minutes apart) or separate refills (after publishing, Summon); a single passing failure doesn't alert. No new drafts are written, and the backlog shrinks by one a day until refills work again. What to do: the refill's error logs say why (a model, Jev or Cosmos DB): Explore, the logs data source, {service_name="machinespirit-app"} | scope_name="DailyMachineSpirit.Functions.RefillBacklogFunction" | detected_level="error". Once that's fixed, Summon New Rites in the Scriptorium.

model.legendFormat: times publishing found no draft, in the week before

annotations.summary: Publishing found the backlog empty {{ printf "%.0f" $values.EmptyBacklog.Value }} times this week (it alerts at 2).
annotations.description: What it means: each of those days, the rite was written on the spot and published unmoderated. Refills aren't keeping up. It fires when publishing finds the backlog empty again, and is resolved ten minutes later, so a week's count doesn't email every four hours. What to do: check whether Refills failing fired too, then Summon New Rites in the Scriptorium.

model.legendFormat: drafts not fully judged in the day before

annotations.summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.Warnings.Value }} drafts in the last day joined the backlog without their scores or repeat check (it alerts at 2).
annotations.description: What it means: a model behind the refill failed, either the quality judge, Jev (the scores for More rites) or the repeat check. One a day can be a passing blip; a refill after publishing writes about one draft a day. The drafts still join the backlog: an unscored one goes last in the Augury until the next refill scores it, and one not checked for repeats is never checked again. It fires while warnings keep coming, and is resolved ten minutes after the last, so a day's count doesn't email every four hours. What to do: each warning's Reason says which model failed and why, e.g. a 429 rate limit (two Summons at once), an expired key, or a model down. Explore, the logs data source, {service_name="machinespirit-app"} | scope_name="DailyMachineSpirit.Functions.Generation.BacklogRefiller" | detected_level="warn". Read any draft the warnings say wasn't checked for repeats yourself.

model.legendFormat: share of requests that failed, over ten minutes

annotations.summary: {{ humanizePercentage $values.FailedShare.Value }} of production's requests failed (5xx) over ten minutes (it alerts above 5% for ten minutes).
annotations.description: What it means: readers are getting errors. It counts only when there were at least ten requests in ten minutes, so one failure on a quiet night doesn't alert. What to do: the dashboard's Traffic row shows which function; its error logs say why (often Cosmos DB).

model.legendFormat: share of Today's checks that passed, over 45 minutes
model.expr: sum(increase(probe_all_success_sum{job="Daily Machine Spirit Today"}[45m])) / sum(increase(probe_all_success_count{job="Daily Machine Spirit Today"}[45m]))

annotations.summary: {{ if eq (len $values) 0 }}No checks of Today ran in the last 45 minutes.{{ else }}Only {{ humanizePercentage $values.Passed.Value }} of the last 45 minutes' checks of Today passed (it alerts below 50%).{{ end }}
annotations.description: What it means: Synthetic Monitoring loads Today through Cloudflare, as readers do, every 15 minutes from two probes (Daily Machine Spirit Today, observability/synthetics/todays-rite.js), six runs in 45 minutes; one probe failing alone doesn't alert. A check fails when Today doesn't answer 200, when Cloudflare served a STALE copy because the app didn't answer (readers still see the site, read-only), or when Today doesn't show today's rite after 01:30 UTC. What to do: the check's own logs in Synthetic Monitoring say which. If no checks ran, the check was paused or deleted: run tools/grafana-synthetics.ps1.

model.legendFormat: app processes that reported in the 26 hours before

annotations.summary: Production has sent no telemetry for 26 hours.
annotations.description: What it means: the app sleeps when nobody visits, but the DailyRite timer wakes it every midnight, so a day of silence means the export is broken or the app is down. Every other alert is blind until this is fixed. What to do: check that the site answers, then production's OtlpHeaders token (revoked, or read-only).
